title: ROV, camera and lights fail at the object

tellings.quote: >> Yep. And when we have dive on it, the camera stops working, the light stops working.

plain: In 2011, at a strange object found on the floor of the Baltic Sea, an underwater robot's camera and lights stopped working whenever it dived on the object. Dennis Asberg, a treasure hunter whose team was there, tells Michels this happened to them: "when we have dive on it, the camera stops working, the light stops working." He tells it as one of the odd things suggesting the object is more than ordinary rock.
